templates: The director of the film {} is
The composer of the original score for the film {} is
spec.instruction: Famous films released before 2020, with one director and one clearly credited original-score composer. Exclude co-directors, co-composers, compilation soundtracks, ambiguous remake titles. Mix decades, genres, countries; at least one quarter non-Hollywood. Use full person names. Titles must identify the film unambiguously without added metadata.
